features:
[Main]

[Features]

Redeem All Code → Redeems all preset in-game codes automatically.

[Gui]

Show Settings UI → Makes the game’s settings menu visible.

Show VIP UI → Makes the VIP interface visible.

Show Stats UI → Makes the stats screen visible.

Show Individual Unit UI → Shows the detailed unit shop screen.

Show Unit Shop UI → Shows the general unit shop screen.

[Launch]

[🌿 Classic Mode]

Select Player Amount → Dropdown to pick lobby player capacity (1–4).

Select Map → Dropdown to choose map (Garden, Enchanted Jungle, Tropical Island).

Auto Launch Classic Mode → Auto-finds an empty lobby matching chosen settings, joins it, and sets the selected map.

[Visual]

[ESP Settings]

Show Name

Show Health

Show Distance

Show Healthbar

Show Boxes

Show Chams

Show Skeletons + Skeleton Thickness slider

Show Tracers + Tracer Origin dropdown & Tracer Thickness slider

Show Head Dots + Head Dot Size slider

Box Line Width slider

Use Team Colors

Default ESP Color picker

Fadeout Enabled + Fadeout Distance slider

Text Scaled

Font Size slider

Font Type dropdown

[Player]

[👤 LocalPlayer Settings]

WalkSpeed → Custom movement speed.

JumpPower → Custom jump height.

Max Camera Zoom → Adjusts maximum camera zoom-out distance.

[Shop]

[🔗 Group]

Auto Collect Group Reward → Automatically claims group join reward.

[🔮 Summon]

Select Egg → Choose summon quantity (1 or 10).

Select Star → Select summon rarity (1–6 stars).

Auto Hatch Selected Summon → Buys the chosen summon rarity automatically.

[🧙‍♂️ Wandering Trader]

Select Star → Select rarity for trader purchases (1–6 stars).

Auto Buy Selected Summon → Buys matching rarity from wandering trader.

Teleport to Merchant → Teleports to trader at set intervals for auto-buy.

Choose Time → Adjust teleport interval slider.

[Misc]

[⚙️ Server]

Rejoin → Rejoins the same server.
Garden Tower Defense
Server Hop → Joins a random different server.
